summary_en: This Phase 1 first-in-human study tests TORL-1-23, an antibody drug conjugate, in adults with advanced cancer, including advanced solid tumors, ovarian cancer, endometrial cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer. The record does not state how the drug is given or how often or how long it is given. The study will evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and antitumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 en humanos por primera vez evalúa TORL-1-23, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, en adultos con cáncer avanzado, incluidos tumores sólidos avanzados, cáncer de ovario, cáncer de endometrio y cáncer de pulmón no microcítico. El registro no indica cómo se administra el fármaco ni con qué frecuencia o durante cuánto tiempo. El estudio evaluará la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1
not_for: Has not recovered to grade 1 or lower from acute side effects of earlier therapy (except hair loss)
Chemotherapy, investigational, or other cancer therapy within 14 days (small molecule) or 28 days (biologic) before first dose
Serious uncontrolled medical disorder, nonmalignant systemic disease, or active uncontrolled infection; significant cardiac disease history
History of myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or AML, or another cancer within 3 years (some low-risk cancers are not excluded)
